instruction: Add 'CODE' to the slide and make the background yellow.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a note 'CODE' to the slide and changing background color to yellow (RGB: 255, 255, 0). The evaluator checks both the note text (case-sensitive) and the background color. Custom getter extracts both note text and background RGB from the PPTX file, and custom metric compares them with expected values (50% score for note match, 50% for color match).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: (1) note text 'CODE' with case-sensitive exact match, (2) yellow background color RGB(255,255,0) with exact RGB comparison

Getter properly extracts slide note from notes_text_frame.text (impress.py:38) and converts background RGB color to tuple format explicitly on lines 45 and 50: background_rgb = (rgb_color[0], rgb_color[1], rgb_color[2])
Metric correctly implements 50/50 scoring: 0.5 for note match (impress.py:21-22), 0.5 for color match (impress.py:35-36), with proper tuple comparison logic
Edge cases handled: missing file returns empty note and None RGB, slide index bounds checked, missing notes returns empty string, non-solid fill returns None
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S (line 51-53) to ensure user changes are persisted before verification
Color extraction handles both solid fill (type 1) and inherited master background (type 5), covering common LibreOffice Impress background scenarios
